description: Liquefaction resistance of MICP treated sands is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "experimental", published or maintained by Jason DeJong, University of California Davis (ucdavis.edu). A set of 1-m radius centrifuge tests on saturated loose Ottawa sand models treated to various cementation levels and subjected to multiple shaking events. Changes in cone penetration resistance and shear wave velocity are monitored throughout each test. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "experimental" project. Keywords: centrifuge, MICP, liquefaction, sand, CPT, shear wave velocity. Published 2020-04-15. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
